title: A ground in winter.
deck: John Ball’s photograph preserves another Hawthorns.
body: John Ball’s photograph shows The Hawthorns in snowy conditions in 1969. Its stands, open spaces and winter pitch offer a striking comparison with the floodlit panorama from 2013.

A ground is an archive in its own right, repeatedly altered while the place name stays the same. Enlarge the photograph, then compare it with the later view. The two images document different moments; neither is presented as a reconstruction of opening day or a particular match.
